obligations.text: Every rustev.definition/1 document compiles to the same rustev.plan/2 bytes and PlanId as before this spec, evaluates to the same judgment and rustev.evidence/1 bytes, and no existing refusal changes category or order.

A value's grade is never higher than the minimum of its source ceiling, its definition cap, its snapshot claim and the grades of the graded values it was computed from, except through a corroboration step whose supporting checks read values of at least the upgraded grade.
A map key, list item or record that fails its presence predicate is absent, and reading an absent value is missing_evidence; key existence alone is never presence.
merge_fields@1 never takes a base field the field's rule does not name; a field its rule cannot fill is absent, never a fallback value.

The compiler refuses a hard gate, or a grade requirement, that reads a value whose static grade ceiling is below the required grade, with category 13 grade_requirement, or category 14 uncorroborated_hint when the ceiling is hint and no corroboration step raises it.

Every disagreement between accepted snapshot entries and every corroboration contradiction is resolved only by a declared rule and recorded in rustev.evidence/2 with each value's digest, source and grade.

sectionHeadings: 032: Evidence quality: grades, presence predicates, typed joins, corroboration and conflict policy (amends 002 and 003)
record.summary: An amendment of approved specs 002 and 003 (R-16), for #76 child B2. Adds an ordered evidence grade (`authoritative`, `cached`, `estimated`, `hint`) and value metadata (grade, provenance set, sources, oldest as-of) to every value of a plan that opts in, declared per field by a new context source descriptor (`rustev.source/1`) and lowered, never raised, by the definition; presence predicates so key existence is never presence; typed keyed joins (`join_keyed@1`) and per-field merges (`merge_fields@1`) with no implicit fallback; a corroboration step, the only way a grade rises; and a per-fact conflict policy that makes silent last-writer-wins impossible. Introduces the shared #76 track versions `rustev.definition/2`, `rustev.plan/3`, `rustev.snapshot/2`, `rustev.evidence/2`, `rustev.run/3` and the registry `rustev.exact/2`, to which later #76 specs add optional members; every version 1 definition keeps its bytes, its plan and its `PlanId`. Approved (A-29); implementation is in progress in increments (see the implementation record).
